name: fix cython source for numpy 2.x api compatibility
definition: Adapt the cython/cython-adjacent source so its build works against an existing newer numpy and no longer uses removed or changed legacy numpy C API.
failure_mode: Build fails or imports crash due to stale numpy API usage.

name: generate and protect a 2048-bit rsa private key
definition: produce a 2048-bit rsa private key file and set a private access mode on it.
failure_mode: wrong key length or overly open permissions fails the key checks
